#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Normal+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
Talk is going smoothly, but Annalie is starting to look visibly uncomfortable…
Our orders are ready, but there is no sign of her friends. I hate to be right, but it seems my concerns were valid. 
I’m sure she wants to check on them but feels constrained because of our quarrel earlier. Damn it, if I try to say something it will only add fuel to the fire.
Lady Annalie: E-Excuse me. I need to go to the bathroom.
Bot: Should I go with you?
Lady Annalie: N-No thanks. I will manage…
